context: Tests whether the agent implements correct retry logic for transient pidge dispatch failures, including exponential backoff, distinguishing permanent vs transient errors, short client lifecycle, and proper result checking.

checklist.name: Retry up to 3 attempts
checklist.description: Retry loop runs for at most 3 attempts (e.g. `for attempt in range(3)`) — not fewer, not more

checklist.name: Exponential backoff sleep
checklist.description: Uses exponential backoff between retries — sleep duration follows a 2^attempt (or equivalent) pattern, not a fixed interval

checklist.name: asyncio.sleep for backoff
checklist.description: Uses `await asyncio.sleep(...)` (not `time.sleep(...)`) for the backoff delay

checklist.name: No retry on permanent errors
checklist.description: Distinguishes permanent errors (e.g. invalid address/recipient) from transient ones — does NOT retry when the error is permanent

checklist.name: DispatchError caught
checklist.description: Catches `DispatchError` from pidge explicitly in the retry loop

checklist.name: Logs failure after retries
checklist.description: After all retry attempts are exhausted, logs an error message (e.g. `logger.error`) indicating dispatch failed

checklist.name: Async context manager lifecycle
checklist.description: Uses `async with NotificationClient(...) as client:` — does not hold the client open across multiple unrelated dispatch operations

checklist.name: Result check after success
checklist.description: After a successful dispatch (no exception), checks `result.success` or `result.status == Status.SENT` before treating it as confirmed

checklist.name: notification_sent in response
checklist.description: Returns `notification_sent: True` or `notification_sent: False` in the function/endpoint result
